items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You knew Matoya? No, I know people who played with him. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Matoya used to play with him. He played with white too, several times.

ctx.x: I know white people that are proud to have played with on Matoya. He passed. You knew Matoya? No, I know people who played with him. There are plenty of white people who say, oh yeah, I've played with him.
Matoya used to play with him. He played with white too, several times. Oh yeah.

Did you ever know George Schilling, Happy Schilling? Yeah. The white trombone player? He had a band, he called it Schilling's Black and White Band. Half white and half colored. They had plenty of bands. They used to play a lot of white bands then. Yeah.
